title: CASCADE certified-discrimination + differentiable-propagation result set

criterion_2_modification_discrimination.claim: modification discrimination: the certified off-target readout distinguishes a chemically modified guide from its parent in the correct direction

subgate_d4d1.certificate: E is linear in occupancy and D1/D4 hit the same sites, so E(D4) = (occ_D4/occ_D1) E(D1); occ_D4 < occ_D1 implies E(D4) < E(D1) by construction
subgate_d4d1.ddG_model: g7 (S)-GNA modeled as a Watson-Crick A->C mismatch (real ViennaRNA duplexfold); an upper bound on the true GNA penalty (ViennaRNA has no GNA sugar parameters)

criterion_1_transfer.claim: miRNA -> siRNA transfer: a predictor trained on the data-rich miRNA corpus beats the mechanistic seed baseline on the held-out siRNA off-target studies

pre_registered.criterion_1: learned mean per-condition Spearman beats the mechanistic seed-count baseline by at least margin_spearman
pre_registered.criterion_2: reproduces the (S)-GNA KS direction on GSE184929: the model predicts MORE off-target for the parent D1 than for the (S)-GNA-destabilized D4, matching the measured shift
pre_registered.decision_rule: PASS only if BOTH criteria hold; otherwise FAIL and do not build the generator

pre_registered.criterion_b: the learned-minus-baseline margin is positive on BOTH the Schlegel and Patel held-out studies separately (not just pooled)
pre_registered.criterion_c: the D4 < D1 discrimination still holds in the retrained model (E(D4) < E(D1))
pre_registered.baseline: SeedMatchR + seed-duplex-Tm = occupancy(seed dG) * seed-match count (no learning, no propagation)
pre_registered.decision_rule: PASS only if (a) AND (b) AND (c); otherwise FAIL

criterion1_retrain_learned.model: modification-aware occupancy + learned binding head + MonotoneEquilibriumPropagation (learned alpha=0.388, w=0.490), pre-trained on McGeary

demarcation.criterion_2_modification_discrimination: PASS with certificate. The monotone modification-aware readout reproduces E(D4) < E(D1) by construction (E linear in occupancy, same sites), a count-only readout cannot, and the differentiable propagation that carries the occupancy is IFT-exact on the real 2072-node TRRUST operator.
demarcation.criterion_1_transfer: FAIL twice, both pre-registered. The count-based predictor missed the >= 0.05 Spearman margin (delta -0.0034) and could not reproduce the (S)-GNA direction; the learned occupancy + MonotoneEquilibriumPropagation predictor also missed the margin (pooled 0.0039) and was not positive on both studies (Schlegel -0.0093, Patel 0.0170).
demarcation.binding_constraint: The binding constraint is the independent-study count, not model capacity. Both a simple count baseline and a learned propagation predictor land at the same near-zero margin against the mechanistic seed baseline, and the margin oscillates in sign across the handful of held-out conditions; with only two independent off-target studies (Schlegel rat, Patel human) there is no statistical room for a model to separate from the baseline, regardless of capacity. More independent studies, not a bigger model, is the unlock.

stage_g_generator.reason: Stage G (the off-target-aware generator) requires criterion 1 to PASS. It has FAILED twice pre-registered, so no generator code is written and Stage G stays gated.

headline: Criterion 2 (modification discrimination) PASSES with a certificate; criterion 1 (miRNA -> siRNA transfer) FAILS twice pre-registered. The defensible contribution is the certified modification-aware discrimination and the IFT-exact differentiable propagation layer, not a generator.
